title: [Keyboard Manager] Per-keyboard remap profiles (auto-switch + cycle hotkey)

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The 18 proposals from an older revision have been withdrawn from the current action feed. Current-revision initialization tracing supports a possible first-use default-profile switching defect: Settings can leave the default file absent, and selecting default after creating a custom profile reaches a file-existence rejection. Existing-file and native recovery safeguards narrow the claim. Current-revision build, isolated interaction proof, candidate validation and review convergence remain outstanding; source reachability alone is not behavioral proof.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
